records.title: Rethinking Key-Value Cache Compression Techniques for Large Language Model Serving
records.reason: The review identifies practical KV-cache compression tradeoffs in production serving, including throughput, latency, and memory effects.

records.title: Linear-MoE: Linear Sequence Modeling Meets Mixture-of-Experts
records.reason: Linear sequence modeling plus sparse MoE targets efficient model architectures, but the abstract emphasizes training-system design and does not establish an inference-serving contribution; keep borderline.

records.title: Fast LLM Post-training via Decoupled and Fastest-of-N Speculation
records.reason: Speculative decoding accelerates rollout token generation in post-training and reports end-to-end training gains; the inference-time mechanism is relevant, though training is the stated deployment context.

records.title: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling
records.reason: Prefix sliding drops stale reasoning KV tokens to bound memory and reports faster test-time scaling; direct inference-time efficiency.

records.title: Networking-Aware Energy Efficiency in Agentic AI Inference: A Survey
records.reason: The survey covers compute/network energy accounting and cross-layer optimization for agentic AI inference.

records.reason: Hardware-software co-design overlaps MoE communication with expert computation on multi-GPU systems and reports LLM inference speedups.

records.title: PACER: Blockwise Pre-verification for Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Length
records.reason: Adaptive blockwise pre-verification controls speculative draft length to improve decoding speed.
